statements.t: “AMH had another strong quarter with balanced execution across the platform and resilient demand driving an increase to the midpoint of our Core FFO per share guidance by $0.02 to $1.97 – now representing 5.3% year-over-year growth,” stated Bryan Smith, AMH’s Chief Executive Officer.

In reliance on the exception provided by applicable SEC rules, the Company does not provide guidance for GAAP net income, the most comparable GAAP financial measure, or a reconciliation of 2026 Core FFO guidance to GAAP net income because we are unable to reasonably predict the following items which are included in GAAP net income: (i) gain on sale and impairment of single-family properties and other, net for…
